mappings.coverage: complete qualified original own-body memory projection
mappings.qualification: 655380 skips reserved0, scans signed live physical capacity and cached pointer table; allocated record2a8 descriptor returns to captured free array after unchecked counter decrement. Fresh global table routes descriptor clear and subsequent table cache. Aliases retarget table or clear capacity early. 655fc0 writes lowbyte mask1da with no ID sentinel guard; every mask byte and signed/wrapping IDs retained, including byte store aliasing emitter base. 655fe0 stores prior-head backward link before global head reread;656010 previous-zero path replaces global head without membership check, otherwise fresh neighbor reloads after splice and final own links clear. Aliases/self/orphan output retained.
